\newcommand{\RGmark}[1]{\zsavepos{rg-\RGcase-#1}}
\makeatletter
\let\RGname\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand{\DirtreexFormatName}[1]{\RGmark{n#1}\RGname{#1}}
\patchcmd{\dte@render@root}{\dte@normalize@rowbox}{%
  \typeout{RG-RAW|\RGcase|\number\ht\dte@tbox|\number\dp\dte@tbox|\number\wd\dte@tbox}%
  \dte@normalize@rowbox}{}{\errmessage{Cannot probe root dimensions}}
\patchcmd{\dte@render@root}{\dte@normalize@rowbox}{%
  \dte@normalize@rowbox
  \typeout{RG-NORM|\RGcase|\number\ht\dte@tbox|\number\dp\dte@tbox|\number\wd\dte@tbox}%
  \typeout{RG-BLS|\RGcase|\number\dte@bls}%
}{}{\errmessage{Cannot probe normalized dimensions}}
\let\RGoutput\dte@output@framed
\def\dte@output@framed{%
  \typeout{RG-FRAME|\RGcase|\number\ht\dte@framebox|\number\dp\dte@framebox|\number\wd\dte@framebox}%
  \RGoutput}
\let\RGconnector\dte@draw@connector
\def\dte@draw@connector#1{%
  \typeout{RG-CONN|\RGcase|#1|\number\dte@scratch}%
  \RGconnector{#1}}
